violations.RP-IDMARK-EGC-LARGE-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 2 public source(s), verdict corrected; no official text was opened. Keep with the corrected letter (B). violations.SL-POOL-RECEPT-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 3 public source(s), verdict confirmed; no official text was opened. 2023 subsection numbering not read from primary text but three sources agree from 2017 to 2023-era. violations.SL-SPA-DISC-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 5 public source(s), verdict confirmed; no official text was opened. 2023 title appears to be Equipment Disconnecting Means (one source), so the new entry title may change. violations.SL-POOL-PUMPGFCI-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 4 public source(s), verdict confirmed; no official text was opened. violations.SL-EV-DISC-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 4 public source(s), verdict corrected; no official text was opened. violations.SL-POOL-SWITCH-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 3 public source(s), verdict confirmed; no official text was opened.
